remarks: This bright, well-maintained 2-bedroom, 1-bath apartment presents an exceptional opportunity and is now back on the market due to no fault of its own, ready for immediate, seamless occupancy.  This inviting residence offers a comfortable layout with generously sized bedrooms and a spacious, open-concept living area. The updated kitchen is designed for daily convenience. The unit includes two off-street parking spaces, visitor parking, dedicated storage, and the convenience of in-unit laundry.  Natural light creates a warm and welcoming atmosphere throughout. Residents enjoy a peaceful setting within a quiet complex with beautifully maintained grounds. The location is convenient to local shopping, dining, and transportation.1  Don't miss out on this fantastic, move-in-ready property.
